text: All 3 tests pass. The fix: clamp each delay to `cap` at append time (`min(delay, cap)`) and keep the running delay clamped as it doubles, so no delay ever exceeds `cap` — matching the documented contract and the test's expectation `[1, 2, 4, 8, 10, 10]`. Edge cases still hold: `base > cap` yields all `cap`, `base == cap` yields all `cap`, and `attempts=0` yields `[]`.
